newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine firms buy 40,000 tonnes U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Philippine firms buy 40,000 tonnes U.S. wheat.

text.p: Philippine flour millers bought 40,000 tonnes U.S. wheat for August arrival, traders said on Monday.

Traders said the local flour millers bought 18,500 tonnes western white wheat at $142 to $143 per tonne FOB, 8,000 tonnes of dark nothern spring wheat with 13.5 percent protein content at $181 to $182 per tonne FOB, and 13,500 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat with 14 percent protein content at $186 to $187 per tonne FOB.
The millers placed the wheat orders in the middle of last week, they said.
Despite the weakening of the peso and the rise in U.S. wheat prices last Friday, some Philippine millers said they were planning to go back to the market to meet short term requirements.
"I'm waiting for prices to dip. If the figures are right I will buy," an executive in a local flour mill told Reuters.
